what_happened: Flow stayed fixed; the outcome is unspecified.
report_observation: Compound Specific Analyzer-Combustion Products (CSA- CP) unit 1024; Carbon Dioxide Monitor (CDM) unit 1018; Prefill O2 reading = 20.9 percent; GN2 fill was from video display time 10:53 to 12:31 at maximum GN2 flow rate (pot = 10); Video display time is currently 1 day plus 6 min 10 s ahead of actual GMT; flow velocity held constant
review_note: Table 7.1 leaves the outcome blank and questions the oxygen reading.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded; Report questions the oxygen reading

what_happened: Airflow changed during burning; the ending is unspecified.
report_observation: Flow velocity changed to 9 to 5 fairly early then very late in the burn changed to 4
review_note: Do not infer burnout from a blank comment. The report questions this oxygen reading.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded; Report questions the oxygen reading

what_happened: After airflow reduction, the flame shrank and extinguished.
review_note: One of the six quenching cases in Table 7.1. Published final airflow: 2.2 cm/s.
data_qualification: Published flow values are from Table 7.1; raw display values are retained separately.

what_happened: A dim flamelet apparently burned along the full length.
review_note: The observer expressed uncertainty. Do not convert this to confirmed complete burnout.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded; Observer uncertainty retained

what_happened: Burning persisted despite reducing the airflow.
review_note: No extinction is reported in the low-flow challenge; the final termination is unspecified.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded

what_happened: A short-lived flame failed to spread beyond the igniter.
report_observation: Brief ignition but flame extinguished before spreading beyond igniter
review_note: Table 7.1 says no ignition; the appendix records a brief flame. The logged year is anomalous.
data_qualification: 2018 source date requires review; Appendix clarifies no-ignition shorthand

what_happened: A short-lived flame failed to spread beyond the igniter.
report_observation: Brief ignition but flame extinguished before spreading beyond igniter
review_note: Table 7.1 says no ignition; the appendix records a brief flame. The logged year is anomalous.
data_qualification: 2018 source date requires review; Appendix clarifies no-ignition shorthand

what_happened: The fuel burned steadily to completion.
report_observation: Burned completely, steady, HCl 0.3 to 0.9
review_note: Completion is explicitly recorded. Burnout does not mean the fiberglass mesh disappeared.
data_qualification: Published flow values are from Table 7.1; raw display values are retained separately.

what_happened: The flame went out promptly.
report_observation: Extinguished quickly
review_note: Table 7.1 summarizes this as no ignition. The appendix describes rapid extinction.
data_qualification: Appendix clarifies no-ignition shorthand

what_happened: A flow change was followed by prompt extinction.
review_note: One of the six quenching cases in Table 7.1. Published final airflow: 2.2 cm/s.
data_qualification: Published flow values are from Table 7.1; raw display values are retained separately.

what_happened: Reducing airflow caused extinction.
report_observation: Extinguished as we reduced flow below 3 cm/s
review_note: One of the six quenching cases in Table 7.1. Published final airflow: 2.8 cm/s.
data_qualification: Published flow values are from Table 7.1; raw display values are retained separately.

what_happened: The higher-flow challenge did not blow the flame out.
report_observation: Initial air reading is 15, but Rick did not wait long enough for the anemometer to stabilize; actual airspeed is about 9 cm/s; no flow restrictors installed, but flow only maxed out to 29 cm/s; no blowoff attained
review_note: The highest published airflow was 29 cm/s. This does not establish a blowoff threshold.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded

what_happened: Flame spread reached the full sample length.
report_observation: Initial HCl 0.2 final 0.5, no HCN, flame spread whole sample at 3 cm/s
review_note: Full-length spread is recorded; the terminal event is not separately described.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded

what_happened: The higher-flow challenge did not blow the flame out.
report_observation: Tried to blowoff, but did not
review_note: The highest published airflow was 53 cm/s. This does not establish a blowoff threshold.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded

what_happened: The flame spread beyond ignition, then extinguished.
report_observation: Brief ignition but flame extinguished as it spread away from igniter, further than previous runs today
review_note: Table 7.1 classifies this as quenching, with final airflow 2.6 cm/s. The logged year is anomalous.
data_qualification: 2018 source date requires review

what_happened: Steady burning was observed.
report_observation: Steady burn, HCL 0.3 > 0.6
review_note: The record does not separately identify how burning ended.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded

what_happened: Turning airflow down was followed by rapid extinction.
report_observation: Quick extinction when we turned air down to 3 cm/s, HCl 0.8 end
review_note: One of the six quenching cases in Table 7.1. Published final airflow: 3 cm/s.
data_qualification: Published flow values are from Table 7.1; raw display values are retained separately.

what_happened: Increasing airflow successfully blew the flame out.
report_observation: Successful blowoff! HCl still 0.8 end
review_note: Table 7.1 reports an increase from 11 to 47 cm/s.
data_qualification: Published flow values are from Table 7.1; raw display values are retained separately.

what_happened: After ignition, reducing airflow extinguished the flame.
report_observation: Ignited at 11, turned down to 5 and extinguished, HCl 2.0
review_note: One of the six quenching cases in Table 7.1. Published final airflow: 5 cm/s.
data_qualification: Published flow values are from Table 7.1; raw display values are retained separately.

what_happened: Moving the igniter did not achieve ignition.
report_observation: Did not ignite with moved igniter, HCl 0.8
review_note: Reused sample. Keep separate from fresh-sample boundary measurements.
data_qualification: Reused sample

what_happened: Ignition from above produced steady one-sided spread.
report_observation: Ignited top of sample with retractable igniter and got steady spread of a one-sided flame
review_note: Reused sample. Width conflicts: Table 7.1 says 2.2 cm; the appendix/CSV label says 1 cm.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded; Reused sample; Table width 2.2 cm conflicts with 1 cm log label; normalized width blank

conflicts.why: Table 7.1 and the raw sample label disagree; width left unknown

what_happened: Ignition was followed by reduced, fixed airflow.
report_observation: Ignition at 5 cm/s then decrease to 2.5 cm/s and hold constant
review_note: Reused sample. The report does not state the subsequent termination.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded; Reused sample

what_happened: Ignition was followed by reduced, fixed airflow.
report_observation: Ignition at 5 cm/s then decrease to 2.5 cm/s and hold constant
review_note: Reused sample. The report does not state the subsequent termination.
data_qualification: Final termination not recorded; Reused sample

what_happened: After airflow reduction, the remaining fuel burned out.
report_observation: Ignition at 5 cm/s, then quickly to 2 cm/s (fan pot 0.7); fuel is burned out
review_note: Reused sample. This is burnout, rather than one of the six reported quenching cases.
data_qualification: Reused sample

what_happened: Attempted one-sided ignition produced a short-lived flash.
report_observation: Tried to get one-sided ignition, but flame only briefly flashed then went out
review_note: Reused sample. Table 7.1 says did not ignite. The final oxygen entry 0.9% is unusable without review.
data_qualification: Appendix clarifies no-ignition shorthand; Reused sample; Final oxygen value needs review
anomaly_flags: implausible_final_o2: final 0.9% is more than 5 points below initial 20.7%

what_happened: A repeat ignition attempt again produced a short-lived flash.
report_observation: Tried to get one-sided ignition, but again flame only briefly flashed then went out
review_note: Reused sample. Table 7.1 says did not ignite. The final oxygen entry 40.4% is unusable without review.
data_qualification: Appendix clarifies no-ignition shorthand; Reused sample; Final oxygen value needs review

what_happened: The flame changed from one-sided to two-sided, then went out after a fan adjustment.
report_observation: Alex commented that he thought the angle of the igniter should be reversed to get one-sided ignition, so he tried that; one-sided flame initially but quickly became two-sided; after ignition, fan pot changed to 0.6 and flame went out after a few seconds
review_note: Reused sample; the appendix questions the final air reading. This is not one of the six Table 7.1 quenching cases.
data_qualification: Reused sample; Final air-display reading is questioned in the appendix

what_happened: A brief flame did not spread and died with the igniter still operating.
report_observation: Ignited briefly but did not spread at all and extinguished while the igniter was still on
review_note: Nomex tested at 22.2% calibrated initial oxygen. This result applies to this specimen and setup.
data_qualification: Table A.2; calibrated flow and sample width are not established here. Raw Air display is preserved.

what_happened: Ignition attempts failed to establish a lasting flame.
report_observation: Tried to ignite, flame would not sustain
review_note: Nomex tested at 21.0% calibrated initial oxygen. Brief-flame detail is not specified.
data_qualification: Table A.2; calibrated flow and sample width are not established here. Raw Air display is preserved.

what_happened: A brief ignition flash did not develop into lasting burning.
report_observation: Brief ignition flash, no sustained flame; no postburn sensor readings taken
review_note: Nomex tested at 21.7% calibrated initial oxygen. No postburn gas readings were taken.
data_qualification: Table A.2; calibrated flow and sample width are not established here. No postburn gas readings
